snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Punisher
snippet.description:
Introducing the Punisher!

Dominating the battlefield with bullets and flames, the Punisher provides cover for allies and deploys stable long-range attacks. It uses debuffs and crowd control skills to obstruct enemy movement and inflict lethal damage from a distance.

Perfect for evaluating enemies with seasoned precision and executing deadly missions—experience the Punisher biosuit's combat capabilities today!
